name: 15c qkv walkthrough
title: Three projections turn each token into a question an advert and a payload
subtitle: Section 2 toy: width 2; the token bank asks its question of all three tokens

steps.caption: Each token starts as a vector x. In a trained model it has thousands of numbers; here it has two, chosen so the arithmetic fits on the screen.
Multiply each x by W_Q to get its query, the question it asks. For bank, (1, 1) times W_Q gives (1, 1).
The same x times W_K gives its key, the advert it shows to other tokens. river advertises (1, 1).
And x times W_V gives its value, the payload it hands over when read. river carries (2, 0).
Score every key against bank's query with a dot product: −1 for the, 2 for river, 1 for bank itself.
Divide by the square root of the head width, here √2, so wider heads do not produce larger scores.
Exponentiate. Every number becomes positive and their order is kept. The three add to 6.6344.
Divide by that sum. The weights 0.0743, 0.6200 and 0.3057 add to one, and river gets the most.
Scale each value by its weight and add them up. That sum is the attention output for bank.
The output (1.8514, 0.3800) is mostly river's payload (2, 0). bank now carries information about the word next to it, which is what makes it a river bank.
